description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend (Python) Sr.

Desenvolvedor experiente que construirá a espinha dorsal da aplicação, garantindo que os serviços de suporte ao assistente de IA sejam escaláveis, seguros e de alta performance.

Será responsável por desenhar a arquitetura de microsserviços, gerenciar bancos de dados e criar as APIs que conectarão o frontend e os agentes de IA com os sistemas de backend.


Habilidades e Conhecimentos Necessários:

Linguagens e Frameworks: Proficiência em Python (FastAPI, FastMCP, etc).

Arquitetura e Cloud: Sólida experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços, conteinerização (Docker, Kubernetes) e implantação em ambientes de nuvem (Openshift, AWS, GCP ou Azure).

Bancos de Dados: Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, DB2, etc) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, etc), incluindo modelagem de dados e otimização de consultas.

APIs e Mensageria: Expertise no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e integração MCP. Conhecimento em mensageria usando Kafka.

Boas Práticas: Domínio de Git, práticas de CI/CD e escrita de testes unitários e de integração. Metodologias: Experiência com metodologias ágeis.

Conhecimento mínimo em Java desejável.


100% REMOTA

Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?



Perfil de Cientista de Dados Sênior


Cientista de Dados Sênior com sólida experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de soluções de machine learning e inteligência artificial em ambientes produtivos.

Atuar com Python, SQL e versionamento com Git, além de containerização com Docker e desenvolvimento em cloud (AWS ou GCP), garantindo escalabilidade e robustez das aplicações.

Possuir forte capacidade de estruturar soluções em arquiteturas modulares, com foco em qualidade de código, eficiência e reuso.

Experiente na produtização de modelos, desde o desenvolvimento até o deployment e monitoramento.

Atuar como referência técnica no time, apoiando e mentorando profissionais mais juniores, além de colaborar ativamente na evolução contínua de produtos e processos.

Perfil analítico, pragmático e orientado a entrega em contextos de maior complexidade.



Modelo Remoto

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**

Full-time position.

Pay is $8-$10 per hour paid in USD.


Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.


Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software

Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals


Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

The Senior Software Engineer plays a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable software solutions that power our partner’s core products and services. This role contributes to technical strategy, mentors junior engineers, and collaborates cross-functionally to deliver high-quality code, drive innovation, and support overall platform growth.


Essential Duties:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software applications and systems.
  • Write unit, integration, and other types of automated tests.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical planning and decision-making.
  • Use agentic workflows to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code adhering to SOLID principles.
  • Conduct code reviews and provide feedback to ensure best practices in coding, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and cross-functional teams to define requirements and deliver features.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers to support their growth and development.
  • Continuously explore new technologies and tools to improve engineering processes and outcomes.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET
  • Strong hands-on experience with advanced SQL, including writing and optimizing complex queries, stored procedures, and database-level business logic in MSSQL or similar relational databases.

  • Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and deep hands-on experience with relational databases (SQL), including performance tuning and schema design

  • Proficiency in version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.


Bonus / Strong Plus:

  • AI and Agentic Workflows:  Experience applying AI tools to automate or enhance workflows beyond basic tooling (e.g., Copilot), including initiative in learning and integrating AI technologies to improve development processes and operational efficiency.
  • Open to candidates with either a strong backend (C#) background and deep SQL expertise, or database-focused engineers with experience contributing to C#/.NET services


Key Competencies:

  • Full-Stack or Backend Development Expertise
  • Software Architecture & Design Patterns
  • Agile Development & Continuous Integration
  • Code Quality, Testing & Documentation
  • Cross-Team Collaboration
  • Debugging & Performance Optimization
  • Mentorship & Peer Leadership
  • Adaptability & Continuous Learning


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join an innovative hospitality tech company building scalable, high-impact software.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**

Full-time position.

Pay is $8-$10 per hour paid in USD.


Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.


Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position

  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance

Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals

  • Auxiliar e acompanhar na preparação e realização de reuniões

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

• Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collections issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and

payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts,

graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their

technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income

statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End

Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to Staff Accountant


Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Accounting or Finance degree
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Can work US Timezone schedules 9am to 5pm EST


Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 3,000–3,500 per month , based on experience
  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • PTO after onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.


We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability


For more information, write to

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

description:
Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Buscamos um(a) SAP Basis Expert com sólida experiência em projetos complexos de upgrade, conversão e migração de ambientes SAP.


Você atuará em um contexto global , liderando execuções técnicas críticas, garantindo estabilidade, performance e evolução de ambientes SAP, colaborando com times multiculturais e clientes internacionais.



Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de upgrades, conversões, migrações e manutenções em ambientes SAP.
  • Planejar e executar estratégias completas de evolução de sistemas: análise de impacto, roadmap técnico, cronogramas e execução em ambientes Dev/QA/Prod.
  • Conduzir processos de system upgrade, system conversion, OS/DB migration, e HANA upgrades, assegurando conformidade com melhores práticas SAP.
  • Realizar cutover planning, coordenação de mock runs e atividades críticas de produção.
  • Diagnosticar incidentes complexos em ambientes SAP Basis, atuando na resolução de problemas e mitigação de riscos.
  • Garantir documentação completa dos processos técnicos, lições aprendidas e recomendações de melhoria contínua.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais, arquitetos e stakeholders globais para assegurar compatibilidade e readiness das soluções.
  • Acompanhar o roadmap SAP, avaliando impactos e oportunidades de atualização para os ambientes dos clientes.



Requisitos:

  • 8+ anos de experiência comprovada em SAP Basis.
  • Domínio em:
  • SAP system upgrades (NetWeaver, EHP, SPS, Kernel)
  • SAP S/4HANA conversions (pré-checks, simplification item, custom code remediation)
  • System copies e client copies
  • OS/DB migrations e Unicode conversions
  • HANA database upgrades
  • Proficiência com ferramentas: SUM, DMO, Maintenance Planner, SPAM/SAINT.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com equipes e clientes internacionais.
  • Experiência em ambientes globais ou operações Nearshore é um diferencial.



Diferenciais:

  • Certificações SAP Basis ou SAP HANA.
  • Experiência com ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Vivência com projetos multiculturais.



Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT

Modalidade: 100% Home office



Somos a maior empresa de consultoria SAP do mundo para empresas de médio porte. Torne-se um especialista trabalhando em grandes projetos. Com as parcerias SAP Platinum, Microsoft e AWS, impulsionamos a inovação e adotamos novas tecnologias. Com a nossa visão e ambição, entregamos desempenho de alta performance.

title: Oracle Cloud HCM Consultant (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Eexperience in Oracle HCM, preferably Fusion Cloud.
  • At least 1 real Oracle Fusion HCM project/rollout experience (mandatory).
  • Strong functional expertise in Oracle HCM Core HR (workforce structures, person/assignment, approvals, data quality).
  • Proficiency in Reporting (OTBI/BI Publisher) for building and maintaining essential reports and dashboards.
  • Experience with L2/L3 support, including incident management, root cause analysis, and documentation.
  • Familiarity with Release management, quarterly updates assessment, UAT coordination, and regression testing.
  • Comfortable with data loads (HDL/Spreadsheet Loader) and integration analysis (HCM Extracts/REST).
  • Professional working proficiency in English (mandatory).
  • Oracle certification in HCM (Core HR/Journeys/Reporting) is a plus.
  • Experience in the banking/financial services sector is valued.
  • Available to work hybrid in Lisbon- Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

  • Experiência em ambiente de sistema bancário com COBOL, CICS, JCL, VSAM e DB2.
  • Domínio de processamento batch/online, controle de concorrência, transações e recuperação.
  • Vivência em tuning e troubleshooting: leitura de dumps e logs, performance de jobs e SQL.

  • Atenção a normas de segurança, qualidade e compliance do setor financeiro.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenação do Departamento de Marketing compreendendo Trade, Comunicação, CRM e Programa de Benefícios;
  • Planejamento do calendário anual de campanhas e eventos e elaboração de plano de marketing com o orçamento de despesas de sua área;
  • Controle financeiro;
  • Negociação com parceiros e patrocínios;
  • Interface com agência de publicidade e promoção: elaboração de briefings de campanhas, plano de mídia, comunicação interna do shopping, campanhas promocionais (mecânica, documentação, premiação, prestação de contas);
  • Responsável pela comunicação do shopping com a assessoria de imprensa: aprovação de releases e sugestão de pautas;
  • Preservar a imagem do empreendimento junto ao público em geral e lojistas;
  • Contribuir com a Gerência de Marketing, participando de reuniões sistemáticas com a equipe para avaliação de metas setoriais, acompanhamento dos indicadores de qualidade, desenvolvimento de planos de melhoria contínua e intercâmbio de informações.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e áreas correlatas;
  • Diferenciais: MBA em administração, comunicação, marketing, produção de eventos.
  • Pacote Office Avançado;


Informações adicionais:


O Que Temos Para Você

title: Arquiteto de Soluções - Com Foco em IA
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


No Grupo Fleury , acreditamos que o futuro da saúde será cada vez mais data-driven, inteligente e digital. Estamos construindo um ecossistema tecnológico que integra dados, inteligência artificial, automação e plataformas digitais, com o objetivo de transformar a jornada de cuidado em saúde.

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções, que será responsável por projetar e evoluir soluções tecnológicas escaláveis que utilizem IA, dados e plataformas cloud para gerar impacto real no negócio.


Se você é apaixonado por arquitetura de sistemas, IA generativa, plataformas de dados e cloud computing, essa oportunidade é para você.


Principais desafios da posição:


• Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, incluindo aplicações de Machine Learning, IA Generativa e automação inteligente.

• Projetar arquiteturas modernas baseadas em cloud-native architecture, microservices e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

• Desenvolver soluções que integrem plataformas de dados, modelos de IA, APIs e sistemas corporativos.

• Atuar no desenho de soluções com Large Language Models (LLMs), GenAI, AI Agents e automação baseada em IA.

• Definir padrões de arquitetura para soluções que utilizem plataformas de IA em nuvem.

• Apoiar squads de engenharia no desenvolvimento de soluções com IA, dados e plataformas digitais.

• Garantir que as soluções atendam requisitos de segurança, governança de dados, escalabilidade e observabilidade.

• Avaliar novas tecnologias e frameworks emergentes no ecossistema de AI, Data e Cloud Architecture.


Tecnologias e plataformas com as quais você irá trabalhar:

A arquitetura da companhia envolve um ecossistema moderno de tecnologias, incluindo:

  • Cloud e Plataformas de IA
  • AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, EKS, Aurora, API Gateway)
  • Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, AKS, Data Factory, Synapse)
  • Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE)

Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning

  • LLMs e GenAI (OpenAI, Claude, Llama, Gemini)
  • Frameworks de IA (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face)
  • AI Agents e arquiteturas multi-agent
  • RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
  • MLOps e LLMOps

Arquitetura de Software e Integração

  • Microservices e APIs
  • Event-driven architecture
  • Kafka, RabbitMQ e streaming de dados
  • API Management

Engenharia e Plataforma

  • Kubernetes / OpenShift
  • CI/CD e DevOps
  • Observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible)


Buscamos profissionais com:


• Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto de Software ou Arquiteto de Plataforma.

• Experiência em arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

• Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning ou IA Generativa.

• Experiência com arquitetura de dados, APIs e integração de sistemas.

• Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e cloud-native.

• Conhecimento em DevOps, CI/CD e observabilidade.

• Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Diferenciais importantes:


• Experiência com GenAI, AI Agents ou plataformas de IA corporativa.

• Experiência com arquitetura de dados e data platforms (Data Lake, Data Mesh ou Lakehouse).

• Experiência em ambientes regulados como healthcare, financeiro ou telecom.

• Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital baseada em IA.


Nosso jeito de trabalhar, buscamos pessoas que:

• Estimulem a troca de conhecimento e colaboração entre times.

• Invistam continuamente em aprendizado e evolução técnica.

• Conectem tecnologia e negócio para gerar impacto real.

• Busquem inovação contínua e melhoria das soluções.

  • Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)
  • Carga Horária: 220h Mês - 44h Semanais
  • Escala: Segunda á sexta - feira.
  • Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

description:

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Precisamos de um profissional auto-didata que conheça front-end esejáveis React/Angular O profissional vai trabalhar em conjunto com o time de IA do Fusion, deve conhecer as IDEs de mercado VS Code e Cursor e como utilizar IA, deve conhecer o uso de Prompts e RAG, e ter noção do que sao agentes de IA. Conhecimentos de banco de dados e cloud sao um diferencial. Fundamental ter conhecimentos de Design System e Figma.



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

• Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collections issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and

payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts,

graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their

technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income

statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End

Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to Staff Accountant


Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Accounting or Finance degree
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Can work US Timezone schedules 9am to 5pm EST


Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 3,000–3,500 per month , based on experience
  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • PTO after onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.


We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: ASM Team Lead
description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead the ASM team in daily coordination, prioritization, and escalation management.

  • Ability to mentor teams, run operational ceremonies, and present operational metrics.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Us

We are an industry leader in providing technology solutions in Canada. We are one of the largest technology solutions providers, recognized for our ability to deliver and innovate to meet the changing needs of our clients. Our services include IT consulting, managed services, cloud solutions, infrastructure design and implementation, and software development. We take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive, customized solutions to meet the unique needs of each of our clients.


Position Overview

We currently looking for an Executive Assistant to be a supportive force who empowers our Executive Leadership Team. This role can be operated from fully remote capacity.

This role requires a self-starter with a sense of urgency, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with exceptional communication skills and meticulous attention to details. This person should have experience working in an office environment, performing administrative duties, and providing support to executives. Given the dynamic nature of the executive landscape, we rely on executive assistants to be flexible and consistent while maintaining the confidentiality of high-level systems and our day-to-day operations. You will also assist in coordinating company’s leadership planning cadence, general administrative tasks, office management and support various organizational needs. We are looking for a “trusted partner” who can handle the daily challenges, streamline operations, and ensure the smooth functioning of the business.

The successful candidate will be extremely organized with outstanding attention to detail, time management, and professional communication skills. In addition, they will have solid overall business acumen, approach every task and challenge with energy and tenacity, and handle confidential information appropriately.


Responsibilities:

  • Schedule and manage meetings and other calendar events, including sending and accepting electronic invitations, as well as creating and distributing relevant materials in advance.
  • Plan and orchestrate work to ensure that senior executives’ priorities are met, organizational goals are achieved, and best practices are upheld.
  • Participate in team, management, and executive meetings, take and distribute minutes and action items, and follow up on their completion.
  • Coordinate complex scheduling and calendar management, as well as content and flow of information to senior executives.
  • Being the point of contact for general communications for the Executives they support
  • Assist in drafting and sending communications and correspondence.
  • Create, manage, and file monthly expenses.
  • Assist with travel arrangements and keep track of itineraries.
  • Complete reports and assist with special projects as requested.
  • Manage employee vacation calendars for supported teams.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations.
  • Participate in event planning.
  • Assist with general office management duties.
  • Provide additional support to executive team members, as directed, to ensure that company goals and objectives are accomplished and that operations run efficiently.
  • Support the coordination of personal calendars and activities as requested
  • Provide general administrative duties as requested


Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Education in business or related field is an asset
  • Minimum 3-4 years' experience in an administrative role reporting directly to upper management is preferred
  • Superb written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Strong time-management skills and the ability to organize and coordinate multiple projects at once
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other office productivity tools, with aptitude to learn new software and systems
  • Flexible team player willing to do what it takes to get the job done; adaptable and enjoys a challenge
  • Event coordination experience is an asset

Additional Requirements

  • Must be able to work remotely in Pacific Time Zone – Vancouver, Canada
  • Comply with background check requirements
  • This position requires reliable internet connection, backup power, and the use of personal equipment such as Desktop/laptop, mouse keyboard, additional monitor screens and a headset

description:

title: Talent Matcher - Non Code
description:
About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. This role focuses on high-volume talent sourcing, capacity planning, and fulfillment across multiple client requirements in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end hiring for multiple customer-side non-technical roles (3–4 concurrent requirements).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams.
  • Assess talent supply, identify gaps, and activate external sourcing channels as needed.
  • Oversee capacity planning and hiring ramp-ups to meet client timelines.
  • Partner with Delivery Leads to align on requirements and expectations.
  • Track and report key hiring metrics, ensuring data accuracy and visibility.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in recruitment delivery, talent operations, or global staffing.
  • Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding.
  • Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management.
  • Data-driven, highly organized, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive).


Preferred Experience

  • Data Annotation or marketplace-based hiring experience, including high-volume talent sourcing and onboarding.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or hiring dashboards.
  • Experience in high-growth or startup environments.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.


This role involves close work with low-level system internals, performance instrumentation, and automated test development.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance the PMC validation test suite on FreeBSD for modern platforms
  • Validate core, uncore, and IBS performance monitoring counters
  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Arquiteto de Soluções - Com Foco em IA
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


No Grupo Fleury , acreditamos que o futuro da saúde será cada vez mais data-driven, inteligente e digital. Estamos construindo um ecossistema tecnológico que integra dados, inteligência artificial, automação e plataformas digitais, com o objetivo de transformar a jornada de cuidado em saúde.

Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções, que será responsável por projetar e evoluir soluções tecnológicas escaláveis que utilizem IA, dados e plataformas cloud para gerar impacto real no negócio.


Se você é apaixonado por arquitetura de sistemas, IA generativa, plataformas de dados e cloud computing, essa oportunidade é para você.

title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst – Fintech Consulting Engagement (Remote | Brazil) 300 Software | Full-time Consulting Role
description:
About the Engagement

300 Software is expanding its presence in the US fintech market through a strategic consulting partnership with an online consumer lending company that provides lines of credit of up to $2,000 to everyday Americans for essential needs like medical, home repair, and unexpected expenses. They serve a broad, non-prime consumer segment, making real credit decisions in under 3 seconds in a data-heavy, high-volume environment where credit model performance directly impacts business outcomes.

This engagement is part of 300 Software's growing fintech practice, where we embed analytical and engineering talent within client operations — bringing Brazilian technical expertise to US financial services companies. The relationship has strong potential to evolve beyond analytics into tool development and deeper platform work.


The Role

As a Senior Credit Risk Analyst, you'll work as part of the 300 Software consulting team embedded with the client. This role sits at the intersection of data science, statistical modeling, and credit strategy — with direct visibility to executive leadership and real business impact from day one.

Your core mission is to identify issues inside credit models, analyze loan performance data, and help the team understand whether models are performing in line with expectations — and drive the changes when they're not.


What You'll Do

Monitor and analyze credit model performance, comparing actual loan behavior against model assumptions. Use regression analysis and other statistical and predictive tools to surface insights from performance data. Write complex SQL queries to extract and analyze data from cloud-based data lakes in an AWS environment. Build dashboards and reporting tools to communicate credit risk trends to leadership. Help define which borrower attributes to track and weight in underwriting decisions. Participate in weekly reporting meetings with the US-based team (Central Time Zone, 2 to 3 hour difference from Brazil). Collaborate with engineering and compliance teams to implement credit strategy improvements. Work alongside 300 Software's internal data and infrastructure team, which supports the client's AWS environment and data layer.


What We're Looking For

5 or more years of experience in credit analysis, data analytics, or a related quantitative role. Strong SQL skills including complex queries, data extraction, and reporting. Solid understanding of statistical modeling including regression analysis, predictive modeling, and scorecard development. Experience working with data lakes and cloud environments, with AWS being a plus. Comfort operating independently in a remote setup. Fluent English, as you will be in meetings and communicating directly with the US team. A background in engineering, statistics, or mathematics is a strong plus.


Setup

Remote from Brazil, full-time, 40 hours per week, with hours aligned to US Central Time Monday through Friday. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Contract or PJ arrangements can be discussed.


Why This Role

This is not a typical outsourcing position. You'll be joining a consulting firm that is actively building its fintech practice in the US market, with a client relationship that is expected to grow. Strong performance here opens doors to broader product and tool development work as the engagement evolves.

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.


This role involves close work with low-level system internals, performance instrumentation, and automated test development.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance the PMC validation test suite on FreeBSD for modern platforms
  • Validate core, uncore, and IBS performance monitoring counters
  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other office productivity tools, with aptitude to learn new software and systems
  • Flexible team player willing to do what it takes to get the job done; adaptable and enjoys a challenge
  • Event coordination experience is an asset

Additional Requirements

  • Must be able to work remotely in Pacific Time Zone – Vancouver, Canada
  • Comply with background check requirements
  • This position requires reliable internet connection, backup power, and the use of personal equipment such as Desktop/laptop, mouse keyboard, additional monitor screens and a headset

Along with our partner, we are seeking a data-driven Part-Time Email Marketer  to own the end-to-end retention strategy for two sister companies: a visual, custom-framing e-commerce site and a B2B wholesale moulding supplier.

description:

Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


The Senior Software Engineer plays a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable software solutions that power our partner’s core products and services. This role contributes to technical strategy, mentors junior engineers, and collaborates cross-functionally to deliver high-quality code, drive innovation, and support overall platform growth.


Essential Duties:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software applications and systems.
  • Write unit, integration, and other types of automated tests.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical planning and decision-making.
  • Use agentic workflows to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code adhering to SOLID principles.
  • Conduct code reviews and provide feedback to ensure best practices in coding, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and cross-functional teams to define requirements and deliver features.
  • Identify and troubleshoot issues to ensure system performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers to support their growth and development.
  • Continuously explore new technologies and tools to improve engineering processes and outcomes.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET
  • Strong hands-on experience with advanced SQL, including writing and optimizing complex queries, stored procedures, and database-level business logic in MSSQL or similar relational databases.
  • Proficiency in Angular with Typescript and/or MSSQL
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and deep hands-on experience with relational databases (SQL), including performance tuning and schema design
  • Familiarity with architecture and design patterns such as Hexagonal, Onion, CQRS, Transactional Outbox, and others
  • Familiarity with Azure and/or AWS
  • Proficiency in version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.


Bonus / Strong Plus:

  • AI and Agentic Workflows:  Experience applying AI tools to automate or enhance workflows beyond basic tooling (e.g., Copilot), including initiative in learning and integrating AI technologies to improve development processes and operational efficiency.

  • Code Quality, Testing & Documentation

  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

title: Talent Matcher - Non Code
description:
About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. This role focuses on high-volume talent sourcing, capacity planning, and fulfillment across multiple client requirements in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end hiring for multiple customer-side non-technical roles (3–4 concurrent requirements).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams.
  • Assess talent supply, identify gaps, and activate external sourcing channels as needed.
  • Oversee capacity planning and hiring ramp-ups to meet client timelines.
  • Partner with Delivery Leads to align on requirements and expectations.
  • Track and report key hiring metrics, ensuring data accuracy and visibility.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in recruitment delivery, talent operations, or global staffing.
  • Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding.
  • Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management.
  • Data-driven, highly organized, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive).


Preferred Experience

  • Data Annotation or marketplace-based hiring experience, including high-volume talent sourcing and onboarding.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or hiring dashboards.
  • Experience in high-growth or startup environments.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
Bluedot | BPO Solutions Brasil (Remoto)


International Junior Recruiter - Fluent English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for a highly organized and proactive Recruiter Assistant with strong English skills to support high-volume recruiting operations.

This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build an international career in recruitment.


What We Offer


  • Fixed compensation of R$3,500
  • 100% remote, working directly with U.S. recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12 PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Executive Recruiting, Leadership, Management)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding


Your Responsibilities


  • Support sourcing and pre-qualification of candidates for U.S. clients
  • Conduct initial screenings via calls, emails, and messages
  • Maintain updated databases (ATS and job boards)
  • Draft and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and candidate–recruiter communication flow
  • Assist with administrative recruitment tasks


What We’re Looking For


  • Fluent English (C1) — strong written and spoken communication
  • 3+ months of experience in recruitment
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have


  • Previous experience in Recruitment or Talent Acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments


Technical Requirements


  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

• Apoiar o desenho de soluções integradas, considerando escalabilidade, segurança, performance e interoperabilidade.

• Elaborar artefatos técnicos como diagramas de arquitetura, fluxos de integração e especificações de alto nível.

• Avaliar tecnologias, frameworks e ferramentas que suportem as necessidades de negócio e TI.

• Atuar como ponte entre times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e áreas de negócio.

• Participar de análises de viabilidade técnica e estimativas de esforço em novos projetos e demandas.

• Apoiar a governança de arquitetura, zelando pela padronização e aderência aos princípios da empresa.

• Elaborar a arquitetura de soluções para novos projetos e evoluções de sistemas existentes.

• Realizar avaliação técnica de propostas, tecnologias e ferramentas.

• Garantir a aderência aos padrões de segurança, qualidade, escalabilidade e governança de TI.

• Contribuir com a evolução dos frameworks, padrões e diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa.

• Domínio de ferramentas de modelagem como Enterprise Architect, Draw.io, ArchiMate, Lucidchart, entre outras.
