title: Analista de Growth, CRM & GTM Operations Sênior
description:
A Cartwave Hub tem como propósito revolucionar os meios de pagamento por meio de tecnologia de ponta, garantindo que nossos clientes tenham os melhores recursos para crescer sem barreiras. Trabalhamos para simplificar cada transação e oferecer uma experiência que seja, ao mesmo tempo, segura, eficiente e fluida.


Nossa equipe atua de forma antecipatória, acompanhando tendências de mercado e incorporando novas tecnologias ao nosso dia a dia — com destaque para o uso cada vez mais estratégico de inteligência artificial para ganho de produtividade, escala e qualidade nas entregas.


Mais do que domínio técnico, buscamos profissionais com curiosidade, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e abertura para explorar novas ferramentas e formas de trabalho, especialmente no uso de AI aplicada às rotinas da área.


Missão da posição

Atuar como o arquiteto e operador do stack tecnológico de marketing e vendas (GTM Stack). Sua missão é estruturar processos automatizados que eliminem a fricção entre a geração de demanda e a conversão, utilizando automações de baixo código (no-code/low-code) para integrar redes sociais, anúncios e CRM, garantindo que cada dado se transforme em uma ação de crescimento previsível.


Impacto esperado no negócio

  • Eficiência do Stack: Redução de custos operacionais através da automação de tarefas manuais de prospecção e nutrição.
  • Atribuição Full-Funnel: Visibilidade real do ROI de anúncios (LinkedIn/Google) através da integração direta com o ciclo de vida no CR.
  • Velocidade de Vendas: Redução do lead decay (deterioração do lead) com roteamento instantâneo e enriquecimento automático.
  • Arquitetura de CRM escalável e documentada.
  • Máquina de automação ativa e geradora de receita previsível.
  • Dashboards de performance que traduzam dados em decisões estratégicas para o C-Level


Principais responsabilidades

  • Arquitetura de Automação: Construir e manter fluxos de trabalho complexos utilizando Zapier (para velocidade), Make (para lógica condicional avançada) ou n8n (para escala e processamento de grandes volumes).
  • Gestão de Ciclo de Vida: Criar réguas de automação baseadas em comportamento (PQL), disparando notificações em canais como Slack ou WhatsApp para o time de vendas quando um lead atinge marcos críticos de uso do produto.
  • Higiene e Governança: Automatizar a limpeza de dados, normalização de campos (ex: cargos e indústrias) e eliminação de duplicados para manter o CRM como a \"fonte única da verdade\".
  • Experimentos Técnicos: Configurar infraestrutura para testes A/B em landing pages, formulários e fluxos de e-mail, garantindo que a captura de dados seja rastreável via Webhooks .
  • Estruturar a base de leads no CRM, garantindo segmentação avançada por ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) e maturidade de negócio.
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar réguas de automação sofisticadas: nutrição, reativação e onboarding focado em Time-to-Value (TTV) .
  • Mapear e documentar jornadas do cliente, estabelecendo SLAs (Service Level Agreements) claros entre Marketing e Vendas .
  • Gerenciar campanhas de e-mail marketing, SMS e WhatsApp com foco em personalização extrema via IA.
  • Monitorar métricas de \"North Star\": Payback period, taxas de retenção por coorte e velocidade do pipeline .
  • Liderar a cultura de experimentação através de testes A/B/n em canais, mensagens e fluxos de segmentação.


O que esperamos de entrega

  • CRM estruturado e funcional
  • Fluxos de automação ativos
  • Evolução contínua das taxas de conversão
  • Uso prático de dados para tomada de decisão


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Power User de CRMs (HubSpot ou Salesforce).
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de automação: Zapier, Make e n8n (desejável).
  • Domínio das métricas de SaaS (LTV, CAC, Churn, NRR e CAC Payback).
  • Vivência em estratégias de Lifecycle Marketing e automação baseada em comportamento do usuário.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento básico em SQL para extração de dados e JavaScript/Python para scripts personalizados dentro das automações.
  • Experiência com implementação de tags e rastreamento via Google Tag Manager (GTM) .
  • Vivência em operações de Revenue Operations (RevOps) ou Growth Engineering .
  • Experiência e/ou grande familiaridade com uso de AI em ferramentas de aplicabilidade na área.
  • Experiência prévia no setor SaaS, Fintech ou tecnologia voltada para o mercado corporativo.


Perfil comportamental

  • Detalhista, mas com senso de urgência e foco agressivo em metas de crescimento
  • Mentalidade analítica para identificar onde o funil está \"vazando\" e propor uma solução tecnológica para consertá-lo.
  • Analítico e orientado a dados
  • Proativo e com mentalidade de testes
  • Foco em resultado
  • Interesse por tecnologia e melhoria contínua


Nível de autonomia esperado

  • Capacidade de executar com baixo nível de supervisão
  • Proatividade para identificar problemas e propor soluções
  • Organização para conduzir suas próprias entregas


Detalhes da vaga:

Remuneração: na faixa de R$6.500,00 a R$7.500,00 (a depender da senioridade)

Tipo de contratação: PJ/MEI

Ausência Remunerada: 30 dias por ano, a partir de 1 ano de casa para você descansar, viajar, curtir com a família, etc.

Plano de carreira: Aqui, valorizamos o crescimento profissional. Nossa estrutura de cargos e salários é bem definida, com trilhas claras de evolução por mérito e performance e escopo.


Esta oportunidade é para trabalho remoto , onde será necessário que possua espaço físico adequado, equipamentos como computador e celular, além de garantir uma internet de qualidade.

title: Senior Azure Architect
description:
Alyra Technology

Intelligent Systems for Mid-Market Enterprises

Contract • 5–15 hrs/week • Must be located in Brazil

Please submit resumes in English.


﻿

About Alyra Technology

Alyra Technology builds AI-enabled software and automation systems for mid-sized businesses, with a focus on document-heavy, regulated environments. We combine modern Azure cloud architecture with applied generative AI to deliver systems that are explainable, auditable, and production-ready — not demos. Our work centers on extracting structure, meaning, and decisions from complex, unstructured documents at scale.


The Role

We are looking for a senior Azure architect with deep, hands-on expertise in applied generative AI systems — specifically systems that work with unstructured text, complex documents, and regulated data. This is not a role for someone who has experimented with LLMs on the side or bolted GPT onto a web app. We need someone who has spent years designing production GenAI systems that deal with messy, real-world documents: contracts, filings, medical records, policies, financial statements.

This role is architecture-first. You will turn ambiguous AI ideas into clear, defensible system designs covering data flows, agent interactions, retrieval pipelines, security boundaries, and auditability strategies, primarily on Microsoft Azure.


What You’ll Do

Generative AI & Document Intelligence (Primary Focus)

  • Architect end-to-end GenAI systems for complex, unstructured document processing — including multi-format ingestion, layout-aware parsing, semantic chunking strategies, and document-grounded output generation.
  • Design retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that handle real-world document complexity: scanned PDFs, inconsistent formatting, multi-section contracts, tables, and cross-document reasoning.
  • Define strategies for extracting structured data and decisions from unstructured text, including entity extraction, clause detection, classification hierarchies, and confidence-scored outputs.
  • Architect multi-agent systems that go beyond single-prompt workflows, including agent routing and specialization, tool use, evidence retrieval, citation strategies, and step-by-step auditability.
  • Design evaluation and regression frameworks for GenAI outputs, including ground-truth datasets, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and drift detection — so the system stays correct as models and data evolve.
  • Define prompt and behavior versioning strategies, human-in-the-loop review hooks, and hallucination mitigation patterns.


Azure Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Design and validate usage of Azure AI services including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (vector + hybrid), Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Machine Learning.
  • Architect the broader platform stack: Azure Functions, App Services, Blob Storage and Data Lake, Azure SQL or Postgres, Entra ID, Key Vault, private endpoints, and networking boundaries.
  • Ensure all systems are observable, debuggable, and auditable by default — with logging, tracing, and cost instrumentation built in from day one.


Architecture & Design

  • Produce clear architecture diagrams — both logical and physical — covering ingestion pipelines, AI orchestration layers, storage and data lineage, security boundaries and RBAC, observability, and audit trails.
  • Make concrete tradeoffs around cost, latency, reliability, and explainability, and clearly explain those decisions to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Own ambiguous problems end-to-end and drive them to concrete, documented designs.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience designing and shipping production AI systems — not just evaluating or prototyping them.
  • 5+ years working directly with unstructured text: document parsing, information extraction, NLP pipelines, or document-centric AI applications. This is non-negotiable.
  • Proven experience building production-grade RAG systems, multi-agent architectures, or document intelligence pipelines that handle real-world complexity.
  • Deep Azure platform experience — designing real systems end to end, not just deploying managed services.
  • Strong understanding of how GenAI systems fail in production: hallucination, retrieval quality, context window limits, latency, and cost at scale.
  • Ability to design for auditability and explainability in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments.
  • Strong communication skills: able to convey complex AI architecture through diagrams and written documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • 7+ years of total software or platform engineering experience.


Strongly Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with complex, multi-page document types: contracts, legal filings, medical records, financial statements, insurance forms, or regulatory submissions.
  • Experience with layout-aware document parsing tools (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence, Unstructured, LayoutLM, or similar) and the architectural decisions around pre-processing pipelines.
  • Experience designing document-grounded output systems where every AI response is traceable to specific source passages or pages.
  • Prior consulting or client-facing architecture experience in a regulated domain such as insurance, legal, finance, or healthcare.
  • Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry as part of a broader workflow stack.
  • Comfort working alongside AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code.


Values & Working Style

  • Hardworking and dependable: you do what you say you’ll do, and you finish.
  • Ownership mindset: you take problems end-to-end and don’t wait to be told.
  • High standards: you care about correctness, security, and maintainability.
  • Clear communication: you surface risks early and ask the right questions when requirements are ambiguous.
  • Practical builder: you avoid over-engineering and ship what matters.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year


Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


What we're looking for

  • 3-6 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from
  • Comfort working in an existing codebase you didn't write
  • Working understanding of LLM basics: prompting, context windows, hallucination, evaluation
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or model eval pipelines
  • Observability chops (logs, metrics, tracing, incident response)
  • CI/CD experience and opinions about what belongs in a quality gate
  • A history of writing internal documentation that people actually reference

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year


Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


What we're looking for

  • 3-6 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from
  • Comfort working in an existing codebase you didn't write
  • Working understanding of LLM basics: prompting, context windows, hallucination, evaluation
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration

  • Observability chops (logs, metrics, tracing, incident response)
  • CI/CD experience and opinions about what belongs in a quality gate

title: Senior Azure Architect
description:
Alyra Technology

Intelligent Systems for Mid-Market Enterprises

Contract • 5–15 hrs/week • Must be located in Brazil

Please submit resumes in English.


﻿

About Alyra Technology

Alyra Technology builds AI-enabled software and automation systems for mid-sized businesses, with a focus on document-heavy, regulated environments. We combine modern Azure cloud architecture with applied generative AI to deliver systems that are explainable, auditable, and production-ready — not demos. Our work centers on extracting structure, meaning, and decisions from complex, unstructured documents at scale.


The Role

We are looking for a senior Azure architect with deep, hands-on expertise in applied generative AI systems — specifically systems that work with unstructured text, complex documents, and regulated data. This is not a role for someone who has experimented with LLMs on the side or bolted GPT onto a web app. We need someone who has spent years designing production GenAI systems that deal with messy, real-world documents: contracts, filings, medical records, policies, financial statements.

This role is architecture-first. You will turn ambiguous AI ideas into clear, defensible system designs covering data flows, agent interactions, retrieval pipelines, security boundaries, and auditability strategies, primarily on Microsoft Azure.


What You’ll Do

Generative AI & Document Intelligence (Primary Focus)

  • Architect end-to-end GenAI systems for complex, unstructured document processing — including multi-format ingestion, layout-aware parsing, semantic chunking strategies, and document-grounded output generation.
  • Design retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that handle real-world document complexity: scanned PDFs, inconsistent formatting, multi-section contracts, tables, and cross-document reasoning.
  • Define strategies for extracting structured data and decisions from unstructured text, including entity extraction, clause detection, classification hierarchies, and confidence-scored outputs.
  • Architect multi-agent systems that go beyond single-prompt workflows, including agent routing and specialization, tool use, evidence retrieval, citation strategies, and step-by-step auditability.
  • Design evaluation and regression frameworks for GenAI outputs, including ground-truth datasets, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and drift detection — so the system stays correct as models and data evolve.
  • Define prompt and behavior versioning strategies, human-in-the-loop review hooks, and hallucination mitigation patterns.


Azure Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Design and validate usage of Azure AI services including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (vector + hybrid), Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Machine Learning.
  • Architect the broader platform stack: Azure Functions, App Services, Blob Storage and Data Lake, Azure SQL or Postgres, Entra ID, Key Vault, private endpoints, and networking boundaries.
  • Ensure all systems are observable, debuggable, and auditable by default — with logging, tracing, and cost instrumentation built in from day one.


Architecture & Design

  • Produce clear architecture diagrams — both logical and physical — covering ingestion pipelines, AI orchestration layers, storage and data lineage, security boundaries and RBAC, observability, and audit trails.
  • Make concrete tradeoffs around cost, latency, reliability, and explainability, and clearly explain those decisions to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Own ambiguous problems end-to-end and drive them to concrete, documented designs.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience designing and shipping production AI systems — not just evaluating or prototyping them.
  • 5+ years working directly with unstructured text: document parsing, information extraction, NLP pipelines, or document-centric AI applications. This is non-negotiable.
  • Proven experience building production-grade RAG systems, multi-agent architectures, or document intelligence pipelines that handle real-world complexity.
  • Deep Azure platform experience — designing real systems end to end, not just deploying managed services.
  • Strong understanding of how GenAI systems fail in production: hallucination, retrieval quality, context window limits, latency, and cost at scale.
  • Ability to design for auditability and explainability in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments.
  • Strong communication skills: able to convey complex AI architecture through diagrams and written documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Senior Azure Architect
description:
Alyra Technology

Intelligent Systems for Mid-Market Enterprises

Contract • 5–15 hrs/week • Must be located in Brazil

Please submit resumes in English.


﻿

About Alyra Technology

Alyra Technology builds AI-enabled software and automation systems for mid-sized businesses, with a focus on document-heavy, regulated environments. We combine modern Azure cloud architecture with applied generative AI to deliver systems that are explainable, auditable, and production-ready — not demos. Our work centers on extracting structure, meaning, and decisions from complex, unstructured documents at scale.


The Role

We are looking for a senior Azure architect with deep, hands-on expertise in applied generative AI systems — specifically systems that work with unstructured text, complex documents, and regulated data. This is not a role for someone who has experimented with LLMs on the side or bolted GPT onto a web app. We need someone who has spent years designing production GenAI systems that deal with messy, real-world documents: contracts, filings, medical records, policies, financial statements.

This role is architecture-first. You will turn ambiguous AI ideas into clear, defensible system designs covering data flows, agent interactions, retrieval pipelines, security boundaries, and auditability strategies, primarily on Microsoft Azure.


What You’ll Do

Generative AI & Document Intelligence (Primary Focus)

  • Architect end-to-end GenAI systems for complex, unstructured document processing — including multi-format ingestion, layout-aware parsing, semantic chunking strategies, and document-grounded output generation.
  • Design retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that handle real-world document complexity: scanned PDFs, inconsistent formatting, multi-section contracts, tables, and cross-document reasoning.
  • Define strategies for extracting structured data and decisions from unstructured text, including entity extraction, clause detection, classification hierarchies, and confidence-scored outputs.
  • Architect multi-agent systems that go beyond single-prompt workflows, including agent routing and specialization, tool use, evidence retrieval, citation strategies, and step-by-step auditability.
  • Design evaluation and regression frameworks for GenAI outputs, including ground-truth datasets, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and drift detection — so the system stays correct as models and data evolve.
  • Define prompt and behavior versioning strategies, human-in-the-loop review hooks, and hallucination mitigation patterns.


Azure Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Design and validate usage of Azure AI services including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (vector + hybrid), Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Machine Learning.
  • Architect the broader platform stack: Azure Functions, App Services, Blob Storage and Data Lake, Azure SQL or Postgres, Entra ID, Key Vault, private endpoints, and networking boundaries.
  • Ensure all systems are observable, debuggable, and auditable by default — with logging, tracing, and cost instrumentation built in from day one.


Architecture & Design

  • Produce clear architecture diagrams — both logical and physical — covering ingestion pipelines, AI orchestration layers, storage and data lineage, security boundaries and RBAC, observability, and audit trails.
  • Make concrete tradeoffs around cost, latency, reliability, and explainability, and clearly explain those decisions to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Own ambiguous problems end-to-end and drive them to concrete, documented designs.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience designing and shipping production AI systems — not just evaluating or prototyping them.
  • 5+ years working directly with unstructured text: document parsing, information extraction, NLP pipelines, or document-centric AI applications. This is non-negotiable.
  • Proven experience building production-grade RAG systems, multi-agent architectures, or document intelligence pipelines that handle real-world complexity.
  • Deep Azure platform experience — designing real systems end to end, not just deploying managed services.
  • Strong understanding of how GenAI systems fail in production: hallucination, retrieval quality, context window limits, latency, and cost at scale.
  • Ability to design for auditability and explainability in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments.
  • Strong communication skills: able to convey complex AI architecture through diagrams and written documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Strongly Preferred

title: Analista de Growth, CRM & GTM Operations Sênior
description:
A Cartwave Hub tem como propósito revolucionar os meios de pagamento por meio de tecnologia de ponta, garantindo que nossos clientes tenham os melhores recursos para crescer sem barreiras. Trabalhamos para simplificar cada transação e oferecer uma experiência que seja, ao mesmo tempo, segura, eficiente e fluida.


Nossa equipe atua de forma antecipatória, acompanhando tendências de mercado e incorporando novas tecnologias ao nosso dia a dia — com destaque para o uso cada vez mais estratégico de inteligência artificial para ganho de produtividade, escala e qualidade nas entregas.


Mais do que domínio técnico, buscamos profissionais com curiosidade, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e abertura para explorar novas ferramentas e formas de trabalho, especialmente no uso de AI aplicada às rotinas da área.


Missão da posição

Atuar como o arquiteto e operador do stack tecnológico de marketing e vendas (GTM Stack). Sua missão é estruturar processos automatizados que eliminem a fricção entre a geração de demanda e a conversão, utilizando automações de baixo código (no-code/low-code) para integrar redes sociais, anúncios e CRM, garantindo que cada dado se transforme em uma ação de crescimento previsível.


Impacto esperado no negócio

  • Eficiência do Stack: Redução de custos operacionais através da automação de tarefas manuais de prospecção e nutrição.
  • Atribuição Full-Funnel: Visibilidade real do ROI de anúncios (LinkedIn/Google) através da integração direta com o ciclo de vida no CR.
  • Velocidade de Vendas: Redução do lead decay (deterioração do lead) com roteamento instantâneo e enriquecimento automático.
  • Arquitetura de CRM escalável e documentada.
  • Máquina de automação ativa e geradora de receita previsível.
  • Dashboards de performance que traduzam dados em decisões estratégicas para o C-Level


Principais responsabilidades

  • Arquitetura de Automação: Construir e manter fluxos de trabalho complexos utilizando Zapier (para velocidade), Make (para lógica condicional avançada) ou n8n (para escala e processamento de grandes volumes).
  • Gestão de Ciclo de Vida: Criar réguas de automação baseadas em comportamento (PQL), disparando notificações em canais como Slack ou WhatsApp para o time de vendas quando um lead atinge marcos críticos de uso do produto.
  • Higiene e Governança: Automatizar a limpeza de dados, normalização de campos (ex: cargos e indústrias) e eliminação de duplicados para manter o CRM como a \"fonte única da verdade\".
  • Experimentos Técnicos: Configurar infraestrutura para testes A/B em landing pages, formulários e fluxos de e-mail, garantindo que a captura de dados seja rastreável via Webhooks .
  • Estruturar a base de leads no CRM, garantindo segmentação avançada por ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) e maturidade de negócio.
  • Desenvolver e gerenciar réguas de automação sofisticadas: nutrição, reativação e onboarding focado em Time-to-Value (TTV) .
  • Mapear e documentar jornadas do cliente, estabelecendo SLAs (Service Level Agreements) claros entre Marketing e Vendas .
  • Gerenciar campanhas de e-mail marketing, SMS e WhatsApp com foco em personalização extrema via IA.
  • Monitorar métricas de \"North Star\": Payback period, taxas de retenção por coorte e velocidade do pipeline .
  • Liderar a cultura de experimentação através de testes A/B/n em canais, mensagens e fluxos de segmentação.


O que esperamos de entrega

  • CRM estruturado e funcional
  • Fluxos de automação ativos
  • Evolução contínua das taxas de conversão
  • Uso prático de dados para tomada de decisão


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Power User de CRMs (HubSpot ou Salesforce).
  • Domínio avançado de ferramentas de automação: Zapier, Make e n8n (desejável).
  • Domínio das métricas de SaaS (LTV, CAC, Churn, NRR e CAC Payback).
  • Vivência em estratégias de Lifecycle Marketing e automação baseada em comportamento do usuário.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento básico em SQL para extração de dados e JavaScript/Python para scripts personalizados dentro das automações.
  • Experiência com implementação de tags e rastreamento via Google Tag Manager (GTM) .
  • Vivência em operações de Revenue Operations (RevOps) ou Growth Engineering .
  • Experiência e/ou grande familiaridade com uso de AI em ferramentas de aplicabilidade na área.
  • Experiência prévia no setor SaaS, Fintech ou tecnologia voltada para o mercado corporativo.


Perfil comportamental

  • Detalhista, mas com senso de urgência e foco agressivo em metas de crescimento
  • Mentalidade analítica para identificar onde o funil está \"vazando\" e propor uma solução tecnológica para consertá-lo.
  • Analítico e orientado a dados
  • Proativo e com mentalidade de testes
  • Foco em resultado
  • Interesse por tecnologia e melhoria contínua


Nível de autonomia esperado

  • Capacidade de executar com baixo nível de supervisão
  • Proatividade para identificar problemas e propor soluções
  • Organização para conduzir suas próprias entregas


Detalhes da vaga:

Remuneração: na faixa de R$6.500,00 a R$7.500,00 (a depender da senioridade)

Tipo de contratação: PJ/MEI

Ausência Remunerada: 30 dias por ano, a partir de 1 ano de casa para você descansar, viajar, curtir com a família, etc.

Plano de carreira: Aqui, valorizamos o crescimento profissional. Nossa estrutura de cargos e salários é bem definida, com trilhas claras de evolução por mérito e performance e escopo.


Esta oportunidade é para trabalho remoto , onde será necessário que possua espaço físico adequado, equipamentos como computador e celular, além de garantir uma internet de qualidade.

title: Desenvolvedor Unreal Engine
description:
Programador Unreal (Pleno / Sênior / Especialista / Não aceitamos Juniors)Descrição da Vaga

Somos um estúdio indie em plena expansão. Estamos desenvolvendo um MMORPG de nova geração e outros 2 projetos próprios, e buscamos programadores de Unreal Engine que queiram crescer conosco em projetos reais de longo prazo. Aceitamos candidatos de qualquer país da América Latina. O trabalho é 100% remoto .

Site do estúdio:

Níveis que buscamos
  • Pleno (Normal-Medium) — Programadores com base sólida em C++ e conhecimento funcional de Unreal Engine 5. Capazes de receber instruções claras e executar com qualidade. Dispostos a aprender, melhorar constantemente e contribuir em projetos reais.
  • Sênior (Muito Bom) — Programadores com experiência comprovada em projetos com Unreal Engine. Domínio sólido de C++, Blueprints e pelo menos uma área especializada (replicação, otimização, sistemas de gameplay, UI, etc.). Capazes de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia e critério.
  • Especialista/Senior+ — Programadores sêniores com trajetória demonstrável em projetos complexos e multiplayer. Experiência sólida em replicação de rede (network replication), otimização de performance e arquitetura de sistemas. Capazes de liderar equipes, tomar decisões técnicas de alto nível, organizar outros programadores e documentar sistemas complexos.
Observação: Cada nível deve ser comprovado e demonstrado com portfólio, projetos anteriores ou teste técnico. Não buscamos diplomas — buscamos capacidade real.

title: Vendedor júnior
description:
VAGA: Vendedor Junior

MODELO : Presencial

REGIME DE CONTRAÇÃO: CLT/PJ

OBJETIVO DA VAGA: Atuar no time comercial apoiando a prospecção, qualificação e desenvolvimento de novos clientes, além da manutenção da carteira, contribuindo para o crescimento das vendas e fortalecimento do relacionamento com o mercado.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSÁBILIDADES:

• Realizar prospecção ativa de novos clientes (telefone, e-mail, LinkedIn, visitas);

• Qualificar leads e identificar oportunidades comerciais;

• Apoiar o vendedor pleno/sênior no acompanhamento do funil de vendas;

• Elaborar e acompanhar propostas comerciais;

• Atualizar informações e atividades no CRM;

• Manter relacionamento com clientes ativos e potenciais;

• Apoiar negociações e follow-ups;

• Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs comerciais);

title: Software Engineer
description:
Exciting Career Opportunity: Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure

Location: Remote

Salary: $30K-$60K per year


Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.


The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.


What you'll do

  • Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production
  • Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions)
  • Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits
  • Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down
  • Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates
  • Work with product and design to land features cleanly
  • Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safety


What we're looking for

  • 3-6 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Real debugging experience in distributed systems — you've traced issues across services, not just stepped through a single process
  • A habit of writing tests, ideally born from experience rather than mandate
  • Thoughtful code review skills — you give feedback people learn from
  • Comfort working in an existing codebase you didn't write
  • Working understanding of LLM basics: prompting, context windows, hallucination, evaluation
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical teammates


Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, tool-calling, or workflow orchestration
  • Familiarity with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or model eval pipelines
  • Observability chops (logs, metrics, tracing, incident response)
  • CI/CD experience and opinions about what belongs in a quality gate
  • A history of writing internal documentation that people actually reference

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

Competitive salary

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person

title: Especialista Inteligencia Artificial
description:
Especialista Inteligencia Artificial


Modalidade PJ - Contrato Prazo Indeterminado

Modelo: Remoto Full


Projeto: Sustentação


Descrição Detalhada:

- Profissional especialista encarregado de liderar o design, desenvolvimento e otimização dos sistemas de IA que são o cérebro do assistente de cartões.

- Este desenvolvedor irá projetar e implementar agentes autônomos e fluxos de interação complexos, com foco especial na integração e orquestração de Modelos de Linguagem Grandes (LLM).

- Espera-se que atue como uma referência técnica, definindo boas práticas e garantindo a performance e escalabilidade das soluções de IA.


Habilidades e Conhecimentos Necessários:

- Frameworks de Agentes: Proficiência avançada em LangChain/LangGraph para construção de agentes complexos e cadeias de prompts.LLMs e NLP

- Profundo conhecimento em LLMs, Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), técnicas de fine-tuning e estratégias de otimização de prompts (prompt engineering).

- Programação: Domínio de Python e suas principais bibliotecas de IA (ex: Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch).

- Integração e APIs: Vasta experiência na construção e consumo de APIs REST para integrar o agente com múltiplos sistemas, seguindo o padrão MCP.

- Infraestrutura de IA: Familiaridade com MLOps, contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes) e ambientes de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).

title: Graphic Designer/Carousel Creator (Canva focused)
description:
Job Title: Creative Designer (Canva & Video Content)


Type: Remote | Part-Time (20 hours/week; 4 hours/day)


Client: Fast-growing DTC Beauty & Wellness Brand focused on premium skincare, longevity, and lifestyle content, with a strong community of women interested in science-backed skincare and wellness.


Overview

We are looking for a Creative Designer to support a content-driven personal brand by creating visually engaging social media assets. This role focuses on designing carousel content using Canva and assisting with light video editing.


You will work closely with the founders to translate ideas, references, and written content (e.g., Google Docs or sample carousels) into polished visuals that align with the brand’s style.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design social media carousel posts using Canva based on provided content or references
  • Translate Google Docs or example content into visually consistent, on-brand designs
  • Replicate and adapt existing carousel styles to match the brand’s visual identity
  • Assist with basic video editing for social media content
  • Collaborate with the team to ensure designs align with the intended messaging and style
  • Maintain consistency in layout, formatting, and overall visual presentation


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Canva for creating social media content
  • Strong sense of visual design, layout, and consistency
  • Ability to follow brand style and replicate design references accurately
  • Comfortable working with content provided in documents (e.g., Google Docs) and turning it into visuals
  • Video editing skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Figma or other advanced design tools (nice to have)


Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Detail-oriented with strong execution skills
  • Able to take direction and translate ideas into clean, engaging designs
  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, feedback-driven environment
  • Interested in content creation and visual storytelling

title: Business Partner de RH
description:
Estamos auxiliando nosso cliente, uma empresa de saúde odontológica,  na contratação de uma Business Partner de RH (nível Gerencial), que será responsável por atender a área Industrial. Veja mais detalhes da posição:

Objetivo da função:

Atuar como Business Partner da área industrial, apoiando as lideranças da operação e impulsionando iniciativas de desenvolvimento de liderança, cultura, engajamento e gestão de performance, garantindo que a estratégia de pessoas sustente os resultados da operação.

⸻

Principais responsabilidades:

1. Parceria estratégica com liderança industrial

   •   Atuar como parceiro das lideranças de Produção, Engenharia, Qualidade, Manutenção e Supply Chain.

   •   Apoiar líderes na gestão de equipes operacionais e técnicas.

   •   Facilitar discussões sobre estrutura organizacional e desenvolvimento de talentos.

2. Desenvolvimento de liderança

   •   Implementar programas de desenvolvimento de supervisores, coordenadores e gerentes industriais.

   •   Apoiar líderes em temas de feedback, gestão de desempenho e desenvolvimento de equipes.

   •   Conduzir ou apoiar assessment, planos de desenvolvimento e sucessão.

3. Gestão de clima e cultura

   •   Atuar diretamente em iniciativas de engajamento e cultura organizacional.

   •   Apoiar planos de ação decorrentes de pesquisas de clima ou engajamento.

   •   Trabalhar na construção de uma cultura de segurança, colaboração e alta performance.

4. Gestão de talentos

   •   Apoiar processos de identificação de talentos e sucessão na operação.

   •   Implementar planos de desenvolvimento para profissionais técnicos e lideranças.

   •   Apoiar iniciativas de formação de pipeline de liderança na fábrica.

5. Projetos de DHO

   •   Liderar iniciativas de gestão de desempenho, carreira e desenvolvimento.

   •   Apoiar projetos de transformação cultural e evolução da liderança.

   •   Conectar estratégia de pessoas com resultados operacionais da fábrica.

⸻

Experiência desejada:

   •   Atuação como HR Business Partner em ambiente industrial.

   •   Forte atuação em DHO / Talent Management / Leadership Development.

   •   Atuação com gestão de desempenho e desenvolvimento de lideranças operacionais.

   •   Vivência com operações fabris e equipes operacionais.

   •   Ter atuado com projetos de cultura e engajamento.

Diferenciais:

   •   Experiência em programas de liderança para supervisores de fábrica

   •   Conhecimento em metodologias de desenvolvimento (9-Box, PDI, feedback estruturado)

title: Coordenador de cobranças
description:
A Locar mais é uma solução para simplificar o mercado imobiliário de aluguéis. Trazendo uma opção moderna e facilitada de garantia, fazemos com que o inquilino não precise de caução ou fiador na hora de alugar seu imóvel! Através da garantia locatícia pelo cartão de crédito, tanto imobiliárias quanto proprietários ganham segurança e comodidade na hora de finalizar um contrato de aluguel.


Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Cobrança com sólida experiência na área e comprovada habilidade na liderança de equipes.   • Conhecimento avançado em técnicas de negociação e gestão de inadimplência.
  • Capacidade de análise e gestão de indicadores financeiros.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.

  • Liderar e coordenar a equipe de cobrança, garantindo a execução das estratégias de recuperação de crédito.
  • Negociar com clientes inadimplentes para resolver pendências financeiras e reduzir a inadimplência.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais detalhados sobre a performance da equipe e resultados das cobranças.
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores financeiros para garantir a eficácia dos processos de cobrança.
  • Colaborar com outros departamentos para melhorar continuamente os processos financeiros e de cobrança.


Benefícios:

  • Gym-Pass (WellHub);
  • Vale-transporte e vale-refeição;
  • Convênio médico e odontológico;
  • Comissões e premiações por metas atingidas;
  • Premiações e bonificações por metas e entregas;
  • Participação de workshop e treinamento para capacitação profissional;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional em um ambiente inovador e em expansão;
  • Plano de carreira com sistema de PDI (Plano de desenvolvimento individual).

description:

Cargo: Engenheiro (a) de IA (DevEx) Sênior

Localização: São Paulo/SP

Data de publicação: 20/03/26



Como será o seu dia a dia

  • Definir, projetar e desenvolver agentes de IA integrados ao ecossistema de engenharia (repositórios, CI/CD, ferramentas de gestão, observabilidade e documentação);
  • Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software em todo o ciclo de vida das soluções de IA: design, testes, segurança, observabilidade e performance;

A área é responsável por conduzir processos seletivos alinhados aos valores e à cultura da B3, garantindo uma experiência positiva para os candidatos. Além disso, colaboramos com os gestores para identificar necessidades específicas de recrutamento e propor soluções assertivas.


O que esperamos da sua atuação

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de software (nível sênior), atuando em backend ou full stack;
  • Domínio de pelo menos uma linguagem moderna de backend (por exemplo, Python, Java, C#, Node.js);
  • Experiência com APIs REST, serviços distribuídos e práticas de DevOps/DevEx (CI/CD, automação, observabilidade);
  • Vivência prática com IA generativa ou LLMs (uso de APIs de modelos, chatbots, assistentes, RAG ou similar);
  • Foco em experiência do desenvolvedor e ganho de produtividade;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com diferentes times;
  • Autonomia, senso de dono e capacidade de conduzir iniciativas de ponta a ponta;

  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de engenharia: testes automatizados, revisão de código, design de sistemas e documentação técnica.

title: Coordenador administrativo
description:
Pioneiro no país em gestão de serviços oncológicos, a Oncoclínicas&Co foi fundada em 2010 e hoje é um dos maiores centros de oncologia, hematologia e radioterapia da América Latina.

Na essência da Oncoclínicas&Co , o paciente é o centro de tudo. É para ele que buscamos os mais avançados tratamentos e o mais alto nível de qualidade e segurança. Temos como pilares de atuação o acolhimento e a inovação no tratamento oncológico e a atenção integral e personalizada, com um olhar no indivíduo.

Aqui na OC valorizamos a diversidade e buscamos promover uma cultura inclusiva onde as pessoas se sintam pertencentes. Acreditamos que a inovação nasce de um ambiente diverso, com diferentes perspectivas e vivências.



O que você irá fazer:

Realizar a gestão administrativa e operacional da unidade, atuando de forma estratégica e integrada nas áreas financeira, faturamento, atendimento, apoio médico e facilities. Será responsável por coordenar contas a pagar e receber, fluxo de caixa, orçamento, contratos e auditorias, além de acompanhar indicadores e apoiar a tomada de decisão. Também atuará na gestão do relacionamento com o corpo clínico, organização de escalas médicas, processos de faturamento e autorização, além de liderar equipes de atendimento e garantir a excelência na experiência do paciente. No escopo de facilities, irá supervisionar contratos, fornecedores, manutenção e controle orçamentário.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável: Pós-graduação Gestão Estratégica e Econômica de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na coordenação do ciclo da conta na área da saúde (auditoria, faturamento e pré-faturamento)
  • Gestão de Pessoas
  • Análise de dados
  • Pacote Office



Horário de trabalho: INSTITUTO HEMATOLOGIA E ONCOLOGIA CURITIBA de Segunda a quinta das 08:00 às 18:00 e sexta 08:00 às 17:00


O que oferecemos:


Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos o PROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas

Para contribuir com sua saúde mental, CLUDE SAÚDE – que oferece serviços profissionais de psicólogos, assistentes sociais, advogados e consultores financeiros. Este benefício é sem custos ao funcionário e extensivo aos dependentes

Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e o PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.

É claro que também temos um SEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.

Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos o VALE REFEIÇÃO e VALE ALIMENTAÇÃO.

Para o seu salário render mais temos a ALLYA – plataforma de descontos.

E para se manter saudável, disponibilizamos o GYMPASS.

No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com o DAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.

E para finalizar, nada mais justo do que dividir uma porcentagem do lucro com quem trabalhou por cada realização, não é mesmo? Então, se a Oncoclinicas&Co tem lucro você recebe uma grana a mais em nosso PROGRAMA DE LUCROS E RESULTADOS.

E faça parte do time de pessoas extraordinárias que atuam com a missão de vencer o câncer!

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Product Owner
description:

title: Senior Data Governance Analyst
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Data Governance Analyst is responsible for designing, building, and operationalizing the enterprise Data Governance Program across the full data lifecycle. This role will establish governance structures, data ownership models, classification standards, retention controls, and monitoring capabilities to ensure data is managed, protected, and used in accordance with regulatory, security, and business requirements.


The individual will act as a subject matter expert and program driver, working in a fast-paced environment to rapidly mature data governance capabilities. This role requires deep expertise in data governance frameworks, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to execute and deliver measurable outcomes within aggressive timelines.


Key Responsibilities

• Design and mature the enterprise data governance framework, policies, standards, and operating model.

• Establish and maintain data ownership, stewardship, and accountability structures.

• Stand up and manage governance forums, working groups, and reporting mechanisms.

• Build and maintain the enterprise data inventory and data domain model.

• Define requirements for data collection, ownership assignment, and classification at creation.

• Embed governance and classification controls into system development and intake processes.

• Maintain the enterprise data classification framework and associated handling and protection requirements.

• Map regulatory and contractual obligations to data classes and ensure appropriate controls are enforced.

• Define secure data storage requirements and validate compliance with encryption, access, and monitoring standards.

• Monitor storage environments to prevent unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

• Govern role based access, periodic reviews, and monitoring of data usage and behavior.

• Partner with cross functional teams to detect and respond to inappropriate access.

• Establish secure data sharing and transmission standards and govern internal/external disclosures.

• Maintain approval workflows, logging, and traceability for data transfers.

• Assess data sharing risks in partnership with Third Party Risk Management.

• Develop and maintain data retention schedules aligned with legal, regulatory, and business needs.

• Govern archival processes and access restrictions for inactive data.

• Define secure data destruction standards, validate retention obligations, and maintain destruction evidence.

• Oversee third party destruction activities for compliance.

• Develop KPIs, KRIs, maturity metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.

• Identify program gaps, drive remediation, and support audits and regulatory examinations.

• Serve as the enterprise SME for data governance, providing training and awareness.

• Build relationships with IT, Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and business units to promote adoption.

• Support AI governance and trusted data initiatives.


Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Information Security, Data Governance, or related field (Master’s preferred).

• Experience in data governance, data management, GRC, or related discipline.

• Proven experience building or significantly maturing a data governance program.

• Strong knowledge of data lifecycle management practices.

• Experience implementing data classification and retention frameworks.

• Familiarity with regulations impacting data (e.g., SOX, privacy laws, industry standards).

• Experience working in fast-paced, transformation-focused environments.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to drive initiatives independently with minimal oversight.

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.

customer.

Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

Language Skills

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

title: Senior Data Governance Analyst
description:
Job Summary

The Senior Data Governance Analyst is responsible for designing, building, and operationalizing the enterprise Data Governance Program across the full data lifecycle. This role will establish governance structures, data ownership models, classification standards, retention controls, and monitoring capabilities to ensure data is managed, protected, and used in accordance with regulatory, security, and business requirements.


The individual will act as a subject matter expert and program driver, working in a fast-paced environment to rapidly mature data governance capabilities. This role requires deep expertise in data governance frameworks, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to execute and deliver measurable outcomes within aggressive timelines.


Key Responsibilities

• Design and mature the enterprise data governance framework, policies, standards, and operating model.

• Establish and maintain data ownership, stewardship, and accountability structures.

• Stand up and manage governance forums, working groups, and reporting mechanisms.

• Build and maintain the enterprise data inventory and data domain model.

• Define requirements for data collection, ownership assignment, and classification at creation.

• Embed governance and classification controls into system development and intake processes.

• Maintain the enterprise data classification framework and associated handling and protection requirements.

• Map regulatory and contractual obligations to data classes and ensure appropriate controls are enforced.

• Define secure data storage requirements and validate compliance with encryption, access, and monitoring standards.

• Monitor storage environments to prevent unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

• Govern role based access, periodic reviews, and monitoring of data usage and behavior.

• Partner with cross functional teams to detect and respond to inappropriate access.

• Establish secure data sharing and transmission standards and govern internal/external disclosures.

• Maintain approval workflows, logging, and traceability for data transfers.

• Assess data sharing risks in partnership with Third Party Risk Management.

• Develop and maintain data retention schedules aligned with legal, regulatory, and business needs.

• Govern archival processes and access restrictions for inactive data.

• Define secure data destruction standards, validate retention obligations, and maintain destruction evidence.

• Oversee third party destruction activities for compliance.

• Develop KPIs, KRIs, maturity metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.

• Identify program gaps, drive remediation, and support audits and regulatory examinations.

• Serve as the enterprise SME for data governance, providing training and awareness.

• Build relationships with IT, Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and business units to promote adoption.

• Support AI governance and trusted data initiatives.


Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Information Security, Data Governance, or related field (Master’s preferred).

• Experience in data governance, data management, GRC, or related discipline.

• Proven experience building or significantly maturing a data governance program.

• Strong knowledge of data lifecycle management practices.

• Experience implementing data classification and retention frameworks.

• Familiarity with regulations impacting data (e.g., SOX, privacy laws, industry standards).

• Experience working in fast-paced, transformation-focused environments.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to drive initiatives independently with minimal oversight.

Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.



Sobre a Arauco Brasil



No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Por que trabalhar na EVEO?


Trabalhar na EVEO é construir o futuro da infraestrutura de TI!


Somos especialistas em soluções de nuvem privada, servidores dedicados e serviços gerenciados. Desde 2014, atuamos com excelência técnica, segurança e performance, apoiando empresas que querem evoluir com solidez e agilidade.

Aqui, cada pessoa tem um papel importante na construção do nosso resultado. Vivemos um momento de crescimento acelerado, repleto de novos desafios e oportunidades. #LidereOMercadoComAGente

  • Experiência prática com automação de ambientes produtivos, troubleshooting em sistemas críticos e melhoria contínua de processos técnicos.
  • Atuação sólida em DevOps, Engenharia de Plataforma ou Infraestrutura moderna.
  • Familiaridade com cultura DevOps e métodos ágeis.
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI CD utilizando GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins ou similares.
  • Vivência com containers Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes.
  • Experiência prática com cloud pública como AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em Infrastructure as Code com Terraform, Ansible ou equivalentes.
  • Domínio de Linux e scripting em Bash, Python ou similar.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Prometheus, Grafana e Elastic Stack.
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de redes, segurança básica e versionamento com Git.
  • Vivência com ambientes distribuídos e arquiteturas de alta disponibilidade.

  • Vale-refeição (flash benefícios)
  • Vale transporte (flash benefícios)
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco s/ custo para o titular + custeio de 50% da mensalidade dos seus dependentes

  • Parceria de desconto com instituições de ensino, como: FGV, FIAP, INSPER
